```{r}

# --- DEFINE PARAMETERS --- #

response_variable_selected = "log10_bioarea_mm2_per_ml"
trophy_selected = c("heterotrophic", "autotrophic")

# --- PREPARE DATA FOR ANALYSIS --- #

# Add baselines

baseline = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(time_point == time_point_of_baselines) %>%
  select(ecosystem_ID,
         all_of(response_variable_selected)) %>%
  rename(baseline = all_of(response_variable_selected))

data_for_analysis = ds_ecosystems %>%
  left_join(baseline)

# Filter and mutate

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>%
  filter(time_point >= first_time_point_model,
         time_point <= last_time_point_model,
         !is.na(!!sym(response_variable_selected))) %>%
  mutate(ecosystem_ID = as.factor(ecosystem_ID),
         size = as.factor(ecosystem_size_ml),
         conn = factor(x = ifelse(connection == "connected", 
                                  "con", 
                                  "unconnected"),
                       levels = c("unconnected", "con")),
         trophic_type = as.factor(trophic_type)) %>%
  rename(dis_per = disturbance_percentage)
```

```{r}

# --- MODELLING --- #

model <- glmmTMB(bioarea_mm2_per_ml ~
                   trophic_type * size * conn * dis_per + 
                   (1 | ecosystem_ID) +
                   (1 | day) +
                   (1 | baseline),
                 data = data_for_analysis,
                 family = tweedie(link = "log"))

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model, n = 1000)
testDispersion(simulationOutput)
plot(simulationOutput) # Heterogeneous residuals
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$size) # Heterogeneity caused by ecosystem size
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$conn) # Heterogeneity NOT caused by connection
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$dis_per) # Heterogeneity caused by dis_per
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$trophic_type) # Heterogeneity caused by trophic type 
testOutliers(simulationOutput) # No outliers
testZeroInflation(simulationOutput) # No problems with zero inflation

model <- glmmTMB(bioarea_mm2_per_ml ~
                   trophic_type * size * conn * dis_per + 
                   (1 | ecosystem_ID) +
                   (1 | day) +
                   (1 | baseline),
                 data = data_for_analysis,
                 family = tweedie(link = "log"),
                 dispformula = ~ day + trophic_type + dis_per,)

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model, n = 1000)
testDispersion(simulationOutput)
plot(simulationOutput) # Problem with heterogeneity
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$size) # Problem
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$conn) 
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$dis_per)  # Problem
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$trophic_type) # Problem
testOutliers(simulationOutput) 
testZeroInflation(simulationOutput)
```
